main.description: Ephemeral 6-digit one-time-code pairing session in the personal mailbox Space, hardened against harvest-now-decrypt-later quantum attacks via hybrid CPace + ephemeral ML-KEM-768 encapsulation (I16). Consumed and deleted atomically inside the Gate 3 space.applyWrites epoch-rotation batch.

ya.description: CPace Ristretto255 initiator message bound to ad_a = sha256(ekOtc).

ekOtc.description: Ephemeral ML-KEM-768 encapsulation key generated by the initiator.

yb.description: CPace Ristretto255 responder message bound to ad_b = sha256(kemCt).

kemCt.description: ML-KEM-768 ciphertext encapsulated to ekOtc by the responder.

sealedPayload.description: Mailbox root + epoch secrets sealed under HKDF-SHA256(cpace_isk || mlkem_ss, 'catbird.labyrinth.otc.pq.v2').
